statement: The CCDR compendium reports frequent forest fires, floods, and landslides; 36.8 percent of Kosovo's area is at medium wildfire risk and 15.8 percent at high risk, with forests increasingly susceptible since 2000.
compact_statement: The CCDR compendium reports frequent forest fires, floods, and landslides; 36.8 percent of Kosovo's area is at medium wildfire risk and 15.8 percent at high risk, with forests increasingly susceptible since 2000.

source_refs.locator: Adaptation risks, printed p. 9 (PDF p. 8) and section 2.1, printed p. 10 (PDF p. 21).

uncertainty: The wildfire-risk percentages are spatial model classifications reported by the compendium, not measured fire losses.

statement: The compendium says mountainous areas face flash floods, including in the Drini basin where floods occur every two to three years; severe floods in 2013, 2014, and 2016 caused more than €4 million in estimated damage.
compact_statement: The compendium says mountainous areas face flash floods, including in the Drini basin where floods occur every two to three years; severe floods in 2013, 2014, and 2016 caused more than €4 million in estimated damage.
uncertainty: Event dates and loss estimates are reported from the cited disaster inventory and source literature.

statement: The government strategy identifies poverty, limited health and social-welfare services, illegal construction in hazard zones, inadequate water and sewage infrastructure, and weak municipal land-use planning as factors that heighten climate-hazard impacts.
compact_statement: The government strategy identifies poverty, limited health and social-welfare services, illegal construction in hazard zones, inadequate water and sewage infrastructure, and weak municipal land-use planning as factors that heighten climate-hazard impacts.
uncertainty: This 2018 strategy describes the government's contextual assessment at that time and is not a current service-capacity audit.

statement: The NDC reports drought losses above €50 million in 2009-2017, mainly crop failures; the 2022 drought affected agriculture across more than 10 percent of Kosovo's territory.
compact_statement: The NDC reports drought losses above €50 million in 2009-2017, mainly crop failures; the 2022 drought affected agriculture across more than 10 percent of Kosovo's territory.

source_refs.locator: Climate hazards and drought impacts, printed pp. 58-59 (PDF pp. 64-68).

uncertainty: Past losses are not all attributed to climate change.

statement: The NDC identifies disproportionate climate risks for women, children, and marginalised groups; women own 4.9 percent of farm land despite 49 percent of agricultural labor, while floods can disrupt children's education and services.
compact_statement: The NDC identifies disproportionate climate risks for women, children, and marginalised groups; women own 4.9 percent of farm land despite 49 percent of agricultural labor, while floods can disrupt children's education and services.

source_refs.locator: Section 4.4 on women, children, and marginalised groups (PDF pp. 74-75).

statement: The NDC says drought, water stress, flooding, and weak farm adaptation could worsen livelihood threats and raise conflict or social-tension risks over natural-resource access.
compact_statement: The NDC says drought, water stress, flooding, and weak farm adaptation could worsen livelihood threats and raise conflict or social-tension risks over natural-resource access.
scenario: The cited NDC passage does not specify a climate scenario or dated horizon for this conflict-risk statement.

source_refs.locator: Section 4.3.2.1, rural livelihood and resource-risk discussion (PDF p. 72).

statement: Source dated 2024 reports: The brief names Ferizaj and Prizren as most vulnerable; children facing both hazard exposure and multidimensional poverty face greatest risks.
compact_statement: Source dated 2024 reports: The brief names Ferizaj and Prizren as most vulnerable; children facing both hazard exposure and multidimensional poverty face greatest risks.
uncertainty: No district rates or causal estimates are provided.

statement: Source dated 2024 reports: After 2021 and 2023 were Kosovo's hottest years, family medicine centres in Pristina and Mitrovica reported more child admissions, especially above 30°C.
compact_statement: Source dated 2024 reports: After 2021 and 2023 were Kosovo's hottest years, family medicine centres in Pristina and Mitrovica reported more child admissions, especially above 30°C.
uncertainty: Facility-reported association with hot conditions; no counts, population denominator or isolated temperature effect.

statement: Source dated 2024 reports: Early-2023 floods affected about 22,000 people, including 3,000 children, mostly in Skenderaj and Mitrovica. Average-year floods affect about 10,000 people, damaging homes/schools and interrupting water and power.
compact_statement: Source dated 2024 reports: Early-2023 floods affected about 22,000 people, including 3,000 children, mostly in Skenderaj and Mitrovica. Average-year floods affect about 10,000 people, damaging homes/schools and interrupting water and power.

source_refs.locator: PDF p. 2, ‘Heavy Rainfall and Flooding’ section.

uncertainty: The annual estimate is national; affected people are not all children.

statement: Source dated 2024 reports: UNICEF flags disabled/health-condition and Roma, Ashkali and Egyptian children as facing added challenges; fires increased since 2007 in Mitrovica and Prizren, while human-caused fires removed 13% of Kosovo tree cover in 2001–2023.
compact_statement: Source dated 2024 reports: UNICEF flags disabled/health-condition and Roma, Ashkali and Egyptian children as facing added challenges; fires increased since 2007 in Mitrovica and Prizren, while human-caused fires removed 13% of Kosovo tree cover in 2001–2023.

source_refs.locator: PDF pp. 1–2, vulnerability summary and ‘Wildfires’ section.

uncertainty: Group-specific vulnerability and geographically distinct fire findings are separate findings; not all fires or associated tree-cover loss are climate-caused.

statement: Source dated 2023 reports: KMAC weighs risk, environment/development and poverty in site priorities; hazards contributing to climate impacts receive top clearance priority. Operators lacked climate-specific procedures at report time.
compact_statement: Source dated 2023 reports: KMAC weighs risk, environment/development and poverty in site priorities; hazards contributing to climate impacts receive top clearance priority. Operators lacked climate-specific procedures at report time.
affected_groups: communities using farmland, grazing land and forests

source_refs.locator: Printed p. 39, Kosovo mine-action priority-setting discussion.

uncertainty: Reported criteria/status, not clearance outcomes or current operating rules.

statement: Source dated 2023 reports: War ordnance contaminated wooded hills west of Peja, which faces flash floods, hotter summers and milder, less snowy winters. Clearance released 355,502 m², reopening park trails and resource access.
compact_statement: Source dated 2023 reports: War ordnance contaminated wooded hills west of Peja, which faces flash floods, hotter summers and milder, less snowy winters. Clearance released 355,502 m², reopening park trails and resource access.

source_refs.locator: Printed p. 40, case study 1, Bjeshkët e Nemuna National Park.

uncertainty: Reported land release and restored resource access, not measured avoided climate losses or a causal peace outcome.

statement: Source dated 2023 reports: In Mitrovica, war/industrial-closure migration and weakened services coexist with hotter summers, less snow and possible July–August drought. Clearance restored Barë grazing/firewood access and Bajgora woodland/pipeline access; wind power was exported.
compact_statement: Source dated 2023 reports: In Mitrovica, war/industrial-closure migration and weakened services coexist with hotter summers, less snow and possible July–August drought. Clearance restored Barë grazing/firewood access and Bajgora woodland/pipeline access; wind power was exported.

source_refs.locator: Printed pp. 41–42, case study 2, Barë and Bajgora villages.

uncertainty: Qualitative historical access/restoration case; summer drought is potential, and climate-resilience benefits are described as incidental, not independently quantified.

statement: Source dated 2022-11 reports: Prizren's 2023–2028 rural plan sets out 14 measures and 74 proposed actions with estimated costs of €22.4955 million across agriculture, biodiversity, forestry and rural tourism.
compact_statement: Source dated 2022-11 reports: Prizren's 2023–2028 rural plan sets out 14 measures and 74 proposed actions with estimated costs of €22.4955 million across agriculture, biodiversity, forestry and rural tourism.

source_refs.locator: Printed pp. 5–6, executive summary and intervention plan summary table.

uncertainty: Budget and actions are planned, not confirmed expenditure or delivered outputs; some plan milestones have elapsed.

statement: Source dated 2022-11 reports: The plan proposed irrigation-system rehabilitation studies, water-storage studies, Manastrica Dam design/construction for drinking water and irrigation, drip-irrigation subsidies and ponds for irrigation/firefighting; dam construction was scheduled for 2025–2028.
compact_statement: Source dated 2022-11 reports: The plan proposed irrigation-system rehabilitation studies, water-storage studies, Manastrica Dam design/construction for drinking water and irrigation, drip-irrigation subsidies and ponds for irrigation/firefighting; dam construction was scheduled for 2025–2028.
institutions: Ministry of Agriculture, Forestry and Rural Development
uncertainty: These are commitments in a 2022 plan; the record does not verify construction or completed studies.

statement: Source dated 2022-11 reports: The plan flags women in rural Prizren as potentially responsible for agricultural water management yet having limited water access; it calls for women's participation in planning, early warnings and drought-tolerant seed support.
compact_statement: Source dated 2022-11 reports: The plan flags women in rural Prizren as potentially responsible for agricultural water management yet having limited water access; it calls for women's participation in planning, early warnings and drought-tolerant seed support.
uncertainty: The plan identifies gender considerations and proposed measures; it supplies no local prevalence estimate or outcome assessment.

statement: Source dated 2026-08-05 reports: A June–July 2026 Podujeva survey of 101 respondents across 35 settlements found recurrent, materially damaging floods among participating households, with impacts concentrated on agricultural land and crops.
compact_statement: Source dated 2026-08-05 reports: A June–July 2026 Podujeva survey of 101 respondents across 35 settlements found recurrent, materially damaging floods among participating households, with impacts concentrated on agricultural land and crops.
uncertainty: The survey is indicative of participating households, not statistically representative of Podujeva; report PDF was inaccessible.

statement: The non-representative Podujeva survey summary reports drinking-water interruptions, drainage/maintenance gaps and uneven warning access among respondents.
compact_statement: The non-representative Podujeva survey summary reports drinking-water interruptions, drainage/maintenance gaps and uneven warning access among respondents.
uncertainty: Item-specific denominators vary; precise warning percentages are omitted because the full report was inaccessible.
